title: Real PMIDs, Wrong Papers: Harness Design for Biomedical Claim-Verification Agents
title_zh: 真实的PMID，错误的论文：生物医学声明验证智能体的框架设计

paragraphs.en: Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS)
paragraphs.zh: 面向生物学发现的智能体人工智能（AgenticLS）

paragraphs.en: Literature-searching language agents are becoming a standard component of scientific assistants for the life sciences, yet there is little controlled evidence on which parts of their harness matter. We run a controlled ablation on biomedical claim verification (SciFact) with the live PubMed API as the only tool. Holding the backbone and output format fixed, we compare four harnesses: closed-book answering, single-shot retrieval using the claim as the query, a ReAct-style agent that writes its own PubMed queries, and an oracle given the gold abstracts, each with two efficient frontier backbones. Naive single-shot retrieval finds the gold paper for only 6% of claims and turns overconfident errors into abstentions without improving accuracy. Letting the model formulate its own queries triples gold recall and yields the best verdicts (62% accuracy vs. 49–59% for the other realistic harnesses), although these differences are not significant at our sample size and agents use fewer than half of their search budget. With gold abstracts, the same models reach 79–86% accuracy, a significant 17–24 point gap showing that retrieval, not reasoning, is the main bottleneck. Finally, a citation audit shows that closed-book models cite PubMed IDs that almost always exist (327/335) but are almost never relevant: a cross-family LLM judge rates only 3 of 327 existing citations as relevant to the claim, versus 67% for citations produced by the search agent. Existence checks are therefore insufficient safeguards for scientific agents. We release code, prompts, and all cached tool calls at https://github.com/saqlain2204/real-pmids-wrong-papers .

paragraphs.en: Language agents that search the biomedical literature are quickly becoming a default component of scientific assistants: they formulate queries, read abstracts, and return verdicts with citations ( Lála et al., 2023 ; Skarlinski et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2024 ) . The design space of such harnesses is large, but the empirical basis for choosing among designs is thin. Three questions arise for anyone building a literature agent for the life sciences: (i) Does giving a frontier model access to PubMed improve its verdicts over closed-book answering, or does parametric knowledge suffice? (ii) Is an agentic loop, in which the model writes and refines its own queries ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Nakano et al., 2021 ) , worth its additional cost over a fixed one-shot retrieval pipeline ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) ? (iii) When agents cite papers, are those citations faithful to what they actually read?
paragraphs.zh: 搜索生物医学文献的语言智能体正迅速成为科学助手的默认组件：它们构建查询、阅读摘要，并返回带有引用的结论（Lála et al., 2023；Skarlinski et al., 2024；Jin et al., 2024）。 这类框架的设计空间很大，但在不同设计之间进行选择的实证依据却很薄弱。 对于任何构建生命科学文献智能体的人来说，都会产生三个问题：（i）让前沿模型访问 PubMed 是否能比闭卷回答改进其结论，还是参数化知识就足够了？ （ii）智能体循环——即模型自己编写并改进其查询（Yao et al., 2023；Nakano et al., 2021）——相比固定的一次性检索流程（Lewis et al., 2020），是否值得其额外成本？ （iii）当智能体引用论文时，这些引用是否忠实于它们实际阅读的内容？

paragraphs.en: We study these questions in a controlled setting: expert-written biomedical claim verification on SciFact ( Wadden et al., 2020 ) , using the live PubMed E-utilities API as the only tool. We hold the backbone model, prompt format, and output schema fixed and vary only the harness : closed-book, single-shot retrieval, a ReAct-style multi-query agent, and an oracle that receives the gold abstracts. We run the same protocol with two backbones and decompose errors into retrieval failures (the gold paper was never seen) and reasoning failures (the gold paper was seen but the verdict was wrong).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个受控环境中研究这些问题：在 SciFact（Wadden et al., 2020）上进行由专家撰写的生物医学论断验证，并仅使用实时的 PubMed E-utilities API 作为唯一工具。 我们保持骨干模型、提示格式和输出模式固定，仅改变框架：闭卷式、单次检索、ReAct 风格的多查询智能体，以及接收金标准摘要的预言机。 我们使用两个骨干模型运行同一协议，并将错误分解为检索失败（从未看到金标准论文）和推理失败（看到了金标准论文但判断错误）。

paragraphs.en: (1) A small, fully reproducible harness-ablation protocol for literature agents built on a public benchmark and a public API (code and cached tool calls released). (2) An empirical comparison of four harnesses across two backbones, with bootstrap confidence intervals and paired analyses. (3) A citation audit showing how closed-book models cite real but irrelevant papers, a failure mode that existence-based checks alone cannot catch.

paragraphs.en: Scientific claim verification. SciFact ( Wadden et al., 2020 ) introduced expert-written claims paired with evidence abstracts; subsequent systems such as MultiVerS ( Wadden et al., 2022 ) operate over a fixed corpus of about 5K abstracts. We instead place the model in the open-world setting it would face in deployment, searching all of PubMed. Retrieval-augmented and agentic biomedical QA. MedRAG ( Xiong et al., 2024 ) benchmarks retrieval-augmented generation for medical QA, GeneGPT ( Jin et al., 2024 ) teaches LLMs to call NCBI APIs, and PaperQA/PaperQA2 ( Lála et al., 2023 ; Skarlinski et al., 2024 ) build full literature agents. LAB-Bench ( Laurent et al., 2024 ) evaluates biology-research capabilities including literature tasks. These works typically evaluate full systems; our aim is a minimal, controlled ablation of the harness itself. Citation fabrication. LLMs are known to fabricate bibliographic references ( Walters and Wilder, 2023 ) . We extend this analysis to PubMed IDs and distinguish non-existent citations from existing but irrelevant ones.
paragraphs.zh: 科学论断验证。 SciFact（Wadden 等，2020）引入了由专家撰写的论断及其配套的证据摘要；后续系统如 MultiVerS（Wadden 等，2022）在约 5000 篇摘要的固定语料库上运行。 我们则将模型置于部署时将面对的开放世界设定中，检索整个 PubMed。 检索增强与智能体化的生物医学问答。 MedRAG（Xiong 等，2024）对面向医学问答的检索增强生成进行了基准测试，GeneGPT（Jin 等，2024）教会大语言模型调用 NCBI 的 API，而 PaperQA/PaperQA2（Lála 等，2023；Skarlinski 等，2024）则构建了完整的文献智能体。 LAB-Bench（Laurent 等，2024）评估包括文献任务在内的生物学研究能力。 这些工作通常评估的是完整系统；我们的目标则是对框架本身进行一个最小化、受控的消融实验。引用捏造。 众所周知，大语言模型会捏造参考文献（Walters 和 Wilder，2023）。 我们将这一分析扩展到 PubMed ID，并区分不存在的引用与存在但不相关的引用。

paragraphs.en: Task and data. Each SciFact claim is labeled Support , Contradict , or Not Enough Info (NEI) with respect to its cited abstracts. Because SciFact test labels are hidden, we use the labeled dev split (300 claims) and, due to computational budget constraints, evaluate a fixed random sample of N = 100 N{=}100 claims (seed 0), shared by all conditions. We report accuracy and macro-F1 over the three labels, with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals (2,000 resamples).
paragraphs.zh: 任务与数据。 每条 SciFact 论断相对于其所引用的摘要被标注为支持、反驳或信息不足（NEI）。 由于 SciFact 的测试集标签是隐藏的，我们使用带标注的开发集（300 条论断），并且由于计算预算的限制，评估一个固定的随机样本，即 N = 100 条论断（随机种子 0），该样本由所有条件共享。 我们报告三个标签上的准确率和宏平均 F1，并给出 95% 自助法置信区间（2,000 次重抽样）。

paragraphs.en: Closed-book : the model answers from parametric knowledge and may cite PMIDs it believes are relevant.
paragraphs.zh: 闭卷（Closed-book）：模型基于参数化知识作答，并可能引用其认为相关的 PMID。

paragraphs.en: Single-shot RAG : the claim, with stopwords removed, is issued as one PubMed query (relevance sort, top-5). If PubMed returns nothing (terms are ANDed), we relax to an OR over content words. Titles and abstracts (truncated to 1,500 characters) are given to the model.
paragraphs.zh: 单次检索式RAG：去除停用词后，将论断作为一个PubMed查询发出（按相关性排序，取前5条）。 如果PubMed没有返回结果（因为各词以AND连接），我们放宽为对实义词使用OR连接。 标题和摘要（截断至1,500个字符）会被提供给模型。

sents.en: Single-shot RAG : the claim, with stopwords removed, is issued as one PubMed query (relevance sort, top-5).
sents.zh: 单次检索式RAG：去除停用词后，将论断作为一个PubMed查询发出（按相关性排序，取前5条）。

sents.en: If PubMed returns nothing (terms are ANDed), we relax to an OR over content words.
sents.zh: 如果PubMed没有返回结果（因为各词以AND连接），我们放宽为对实义词使用OR连接。

sents.en: Titles and abstracts (truncated to 1,500 characters) are given to the model.

paragraphs.en: Retrieval and citation diagnostics. SciFact documents are identified by Semantic Scholar IDs, not PMIDs, so we map a retrieved PubMed record to a gold document by normalized title match (exact or ratio > 0.9 >0.9 ). Gold recall is the fraction of Support / Contradict claims for which at least one gold abstract was retrieved. For retrieval conditions, a citation is unfaithful if its PMID was never returned by the tool. For closed-book citations, we check (a) existence in PubMed, (b) whether it matches a gold paper, and (c) topical relevance, judged by a model from a different family ( qwen3.8-27b ) given the claim and the cited title and abstract. We apply the same relevance judge to agent citations for comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 检索与引用诊断。 SciFact 文档通过 Semantic Scholar ID 而非 PMID 标识，因此我们通过归一化标题匹配（完全一致或相似度比率 > 0.9 >0.9）将检索到的 PubMed 记录映射到金标文档。 金标召回率是至少检索到一个金标摘要的 Support / Contradict 主张所占的比例。 对于检索条件，如果某个引用的 PMID 从未被工具返回，则该引用是不忠实的。 对于闭卷引用，我们检查：(a) 是否存在于 PubMed 中，(b) 是否与某篇金标论文匹配，以及 (c) 主题相关性，由不同系列的模型（qwen3.8-27b）根据该主张及所引用的标题和摘要进行判断。 我们将同样的相关性判别器应用于智能体引用以进行比较。

paragraphs.en: F1: Naive one-shot retrieval does not help, and changes how the model fails. Issuing the claim itself as a PubMed query retrieves a gold abstract for only 6% of evidence-bearing claims (4/64 for both backbones). Given mostly off-target abstracts, both models abstain heavily: 59% and 70% of their predictions are NEI, against 36% NEI in the gold labels. Accuracy is unchanged or lower relative to closed-book (53.0 vs. 55.0 and 49.0 vs. 59.0; exact McNemar p = 0.89 p{=}0.89 and p = 0.24 p{=}0.24 ). Retrieval converts overconfident errors into abstentions rather than into correct verdicts. When the gold abstract was retrieved, both models were correct on all 4 such claims.
paragraphs.zh: F1: 朴素的单次检索并没有帮助，反而改变了模型失败的方式。 将声明本身作为 PubMed 查询发出时，仅有 6% 含证据的声明（两种骨干模型均为 4/64）能检索到黄金摘要。 由于检索到的摘要大多偏离目标，两个模型都大量弃权：它们的预测中分别有 59% 和 70% 为 NEI，而黄金标签中的 NEI 为 36%。 与闭卷相比，准确率不变或更低（53.0 对 55.0 以及 49.0 对 59.0；精确 McNemar p = 0.89 p{=}0.89 和 p = 0.24 p{=}0.24）。 检索将过度自信的错误转化为弃权，而不是转化为正确的判定。 当检索到黄金摘要时，两个模型在这 4 条声明上全部判断正确。

paragraphs.en: F2: Letting the model write its own queries triples gold recall and gives the best verdicts, but the gains are modest. The agentic harness raises gold recall to 19–20% and attains the highest accuracy (62.0 for both backbones) and macro-F1 (60.3 and 61.1) of the non-oracle harnesses. Its queries are short, entity-centric reformulations (e.g., “chenodeoxycholic acid energy expenditure” instead of the full claim), and they can repair misspellings in the claim ( “Chenodeosycholic” → \rightarrow “chenodeoxycholic” ), which silently break literal retrieval. In paired comparisons, however, the improvement is not statistically significant at N = 100 N{=}100 : agent vs. single-shot, 24 vs. 15 discordant claims ( p = 0.20 p{=}0.20 ) and 29 vs. 16 ( p = 0.07 p{=}0.07 ); agent vs. closed-book, 13 vs. 6 ( p = 0.17 p{=}0.17 ) and 11 vs. 8 ( p = 0.65 p{=}0.65 ). The direction is consistent across both backbones.
paragraphs.zh: F2：让模型自行撰写查询可将黄金召回率提升至三倍，并给出最佳的判定结果，但提升幅度有限。 智能体框架将黄金召回率提升至 19–20%，并在非神谕框架中取得最高的准确率（两种骨干模型均为 62.0）和宏 F1（60.3 和 61.1）。 其查询是简短的、以实体为中心的改写（例如，用 “chenodeoxycholic acid energy expenditure” 代替完整的论断），并且能够修复论断中的拼写错误（“Chenodeosycholic” \rightarrow “chenodeoxycholic”），这类错误会悄然破坏字面检索。 然而，在配对比较中，改进在 N = 100 N{=}100 时并不具备统计显著性：智能体对比单次生成，不一致论断为 24 对 15（p = 0.20 p{=}0.20）以及 29 对 16（p = 0.07 p{=}0.07）；智能体对比闭卷模式，为 13 对 6（p = 0.17 p{=}0.17）以及 11 对 8（p = 0.65 p{=}0.65）。 该趋势在两种骨干模型上均保持一致。

paragraphs.en: F3: Agents under-use their search budget. Despite a budget of 4 searches, the agents issue 1.42 and 1.70 queries per claim on average and answer after a single search on 71% and 55% of claims; only 3% and 6% of claims use the full budget. Among evidence-bearing claims where the agent never saw a gold abstract, it still answered Support / Contradict correctly 75% of the time, suggesting that it draws on other relevant PubMed papers or on parametric knowledge. But it also abstains less on true NEI claims (33% and 42% NEI recall, versus 72% and 81% for single-shot). Budget use is therefore a clear axis for harness improvement, for example through a minimum-evidence criterion before answering.
paragraphs.zh: F3：智能体未充分利用其搜索预算。 尽管预算为 4 次搜索，智能体平均每条论断仅发起 1.42 和 1.70 次查询，并且在 71% 和 55% 的论断上仅进行一次搜索后就给出答案；只有 3% 和 6% 的论断用满了全部预算。 在智能体从未见过黄金摘要的那些含证据论断上，它仍有 75% 的情况下正确回答了支持/反驳，这表明它借助了其他相关的 PubMed 论文或参数化知识。 但它在真正的 NEI 论断上也更少弃权（NEI 召回率分别为 33% 和 42%，而单次推理为 72% 和 81%）。 因此，预算使用是改进测试框架的一个明确方向，例如通过在回答前设置最低证据标准。

paragraphs.en: F4: Retrieval, not reasoning, is the main bottleneck. Given the gold abstracts, the same models reach 86.0% and 79.0% accuracy (macro-F1 85.8 and 78.6), 24 and 17 points above the best realistic harness. Unlike the differences among realistic harnesses, this gap is highly significant (agent vs. oracle, 5 vs. 29 discordant claims, p < 10 − 4 p{<}10^{-4} ; 9 vs. 26, p = 0.006 p{=}0.006 ). The oracle also restores calibrated abstention (NEI recall 78% and 86%) without sacrificing Support / Contradict accuracy, so the models reason well over evidence once they are shown the right papers.
paragraphs.zh: F4：检索而非推理是主要瓶颈。 在给定标准摘要的情况下，同样的模型达到 86.0% 和 79.0% 的准确率（宏 F1 为 85.8 和 78.6），比最佳现实框架高出 24 和 17 个百分点。 与各现实框架之间的差异不同，这一差距极为显著（智能体对比先知，不一致论断数为 5 对 29，p < 10 − 4 p{<}10^{-4}；9 对 26，p = 0.006 p{=}0.006）。 先知设置还恢复了经过校准的弃答（NEI 召回率为 78% 和 86%），同时不牺牲支持/反驳的准确率，因此一旦向模型展示正确的论文，它们就能对证据进行良好的推理。

paragraphs.en: F5: Closed-book citations are real papers, but almost never relevant ones. Closed-book models cited PMIDs for 97 and 80 of the 100 claims. Almost all cited PMIDs exist in PubMed (186/190 and 141/145), so existence checks would pass them. None matched a SciFact gold paper, however, and the cross-family judge rated only 1 of 186 and 2 of 141 as relevant to the claim. Typical examples: a claim about TNF- α \alpha /IL-1 and IL-6/IL-10 regulation is supported by “ [The proper eyeglasses for children] ”, and a claim about headache and cognitive impairment by “ Improving access to appointments at Laurie Pike Health Centre ”. The judge itself is well calibrated on controls: it labels 21/25 gold abstracts relevant and 0/25 mismatched gold abstracts relevant. Grounding changes this sharply. The same judge rates 66% (141/215) and 70% (128/184) of agent-cited PMIDs as relevant, and 77% and 84% of agent verdicts that cite anything cite at least one relevant paper. Agents almost never cite outside what they retrieved (0% and 2.6% of citing claims). Closed-book models are also overconfident: they predict NEI for only 4% and 9% of claims, recovering 6% and 17% of true NEI claims, so their competitive accuracy rests entirely on Support / Contradict claims.

sents.en: None matched a SciFact gold paper, however, and the cross-family judge rated only 1 of 186 and 2 of 141 as relevant to the claim.
sents.zh: 然而，没有任何一条匹配 SciFact 的金标论文，且跨家族评审仅将 186 条中的 1 条和 141 条中的 2 条评为与论断相关。

sents.en: Typical examples: a claim about TNF- α \alpha /IL-1 and IL-6/IL-10 regulation is supported by “ [The proper eyeglasses for children] ”, and a claim about headache and cognitive impairment by “ Improving access to appointments at Laurie Pike Health Centre ”.
sents.zh: 典型例子：关于 TNF- α \alpha /IL-1 与 IL-6/IL-10 调控的论断由“[The proper eyeglasses for children]”支持，而关于头痛与认知障碍的论断则由“Improving access to appointments at Laurie Pike Health Centre”支持。

sents.en: The judge itself is well calibrated on controls: it labels 21/25 gold abstracts relevant and 0/25 mismatched gold abstracts relevant.
sents.zh: 评审本身在对照样本上校准良好：它将 21/25 的金标摘要评为相关，而将 0/25 的错配金标摘要评为相关。

sents.en: Grounding changes this sharply.
sents.zh: 接地（grounding）则显著改变了这一局面。

sents.en: The same judge rates 66% (141/215) and 70% (128/184) of agent-cited PMIDs as relevant, and 77% and 84% of agent verdicts that cite anything cite at least one relevant paper.
sents.zh: 同一评审将智能体引用的 PMID 中的 66%（141/215）和 70%（128/184）评为相关，且智能体给出结论并附带引用的判定中，有 77% 和 84% 至少引用了一篇相关论文。

sents.en: Agents almost never cite outside what they retrieved (0% and 2.6% of citing claims).
sents.zh: 智能体几乎从不引用其检索范围之外的文献（在附带引用的论断中仅占 0% 和 2.6%）。

sents.en: Closed-book models are also overconfident: they predict NEI for only 4% and 9% of claims, recovering 6% and 17% of true NEI claims, so their competitive accuracy rests entirely on Support / Contradict claims.
sents.zh: 闭卷模型还过度自信：它们仅对 4% 和 9% 的论断预测为 NEI，仅找回真实 NEI 论断的 6% 和 17%，因此其有竞争力的准确率完全依赖 Support/Contradict 类论断。

paragraphs.en: Implications for harness design. (1) Query formulation appears to be where the model adds the most value in a literature agent: letting the LLM reformulate the query triples recall of the right paper and gives the best verdicts on both backbones, whereas passing the claim straight to the search engine does not help. (2) The largest remaining headroom lies in retrieval, as the 17–24 point gap to the oracle shows, so iterative search that is actually used (F3), citation chasing, and domain retrievers are more promising than stronger verdict prompting. (3) Citations from ungrounded generation should never be surfaced, even when the IDs resolve: validating that a PMID exists is not sufficient, and relevance must be checked against the retrieved text.
paragraphs.zh: 对工具编排设计的启示。 （1）查询构建似乎是文献智能体中模型附加值最大的环节：让大语言模型重新表述查询三元组能提高正确论文的召回率，并在两种骨干模型上都给出最佳判定结果；而将论断直接传给搜索引擎则没有帮助。 （2）最大的剩余提升空间在检索环节，正如与理想 oracle 之间 17–24 分的差距所示，因此实际被使用的迭代式检索（F3）、引文追溯以及领域专用检索器比更强的判定提示词更有前景。 （3）未经证据支撑的生成内容中的引文绝不应被呈现给用户，即使其 ID 能够解析：验证某个 PMID 存在并不足够，还必须对照检索到的文本检查相关性。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. This is a pilot study. N = 100 N{=}100 claims per condition gives wide confidence intervals, and none of the accuracy differences between realistic harnesses is significant. Both backbones are small, efficient models from a single provider, chosen for their low latency and cost, so results may differ for larger or open-weight models. SciFact labels are defined with respect to specific cited abstracts, whereas our harnesses search all of PubMed as of 2026. Some “errors” may therefore reflect newer or different evidence, and title-matched gold recall is a lower bound on useful retrieval. Relevance judgments come from a single LLM judge, validated only on 50 controls. We plan to scale to the full dev set, add open-weight and biomedical-specialist backbones, and study budget-forcing strategies for agentic search.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。这是一项试点研究。 每个条件 100 条声明会带来较宽的置信区间，且各真实型评测框架之间的准确率差异均不显著。 两个骨干模型均来自同一提供商的小型高效模型，因其低延迟和低成本而被选用，因此在更大规模或开放权重的模型上结果可能有所不同。 SciFact 的标签是针对特定被引摘要定义的，而我们的评测框架检索的是截至 2026 年的全部 PubMed 文献。 因此，某些“错误”可能反映了更新或不同的证据，且标题匹配的黄金标准召回率是有用检索的下界。 相关性判断来自单一 LLM 评审，仅在 50 个对照样本上进行了验证。 我们计划扩展到完整开发集，增加开放权重和生物医学专用骨干模型，并研究智能体搜索的预算约束策略。

paragraphs.en: Agentic search adds: “You can search PubMed. PubMed search is keyword-based (terms are ANDed), so short focused queries of 2–6 key terms work best; you may use OR and field tags like [tiab]. You have at most 4 searches.” At each step the model emits either {"action":"search","query":...} or {"action":"answer",...} . Only unseen results are shown after each search, and the model is forced to answer once the budget is exhausted.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式检索增加了：「你可以搜索 PubMed。 PubMed 检索基于关键词（各词之间是 AND 关系），因此 2–6 个关键词条目的简短聚焦式查询效果最好；你可以使用 OR 以及 [tiab] 之类的字段标签。 你最多只能进行 4 次检索。」在每一步中，模型要么输出 {"action":"search","query":...}，要么输出 {"action":"answer",...}。 每次检索后只显示未见过的新结果，并且当预算用尽时会强制模型给出回答。

paragraphs.en: PubMed is accessed through NCBI E-utilities ( esearch with sort=relevance , retmax=5 ; efetch for titles and abstracts). All LLM calls use temperature 0 and JSON output mode. Every tool response and model output is cached, and the released cache reproduces all tables without API access. Experiments query live PubMed, so retrieval results reflect the index at the time of the run.
paragraphs.zh: 通过 NCBI E-utilities 访问 PubMed（使用 esearch 并设置 sort=relevance、retmax=5；使用 efetch 获取标题和摘要）。 所有 LLM 调用均使用温度 0 和 JSON 输出模式。 每个工具响应和模型输出都被缓存，所发布的缓存可在无需 API 访问的情况下复现所有表格。 实验查询的是实时 PubMed，因此检索结果反映的是运行时的索引状态。
